### Summary

Windows 10 1903+ and Windows 11 ship with the “app execution alias” mechanism. App Installer (DesktopAppInstaller) registers:

%LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\WindowsApps\python.exe

%LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\WindowsApps\python3.exe

uv python install <version> --default adds the path to the user PATH, but that has lower priority than the invalid python alias above.

Can --default instead add its path to the system PATH?
